office_hours: Our customer support office hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Indian Standard Time. We are closed on Sundays and national holidays.
mailing_address: You can mail documents or correspondence to Observe Insurance, Attention: Claims Department, Prestige Tech Park, 4th Floor, Marathahalli-Sarjapur Outer Ring Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103.
how_to_start_a_claim: To file a new claim, you can visit our secure website at observeinsurance.in/claims or call our 24/7 claims helpline at 1800-209-0199.
general_claims_process: Once a claim is submitted, a surveyor is assigned within 24 to 48 hours to assess the damage or medical records. If additional documents are required, you will be notified via SMS and email. Once all documents are approved, settlement is processed via direct bank transfer within 5 to 7 business days.
